description: Hand-labeled ground truth for clarification precision/recall over the Olist demo DB. ambiguous=true means a well-built copilot SHOULD ask before answering; flagging a clear question is over-asking. dimension names the primary ambiguity. Seeds the Phase 5 gallery.

questions.question: Who are the top sellers?
questions.note: top by revenue, order count, or review score?

questions.question: What are the best products?
questions.note: best by sales, rating, or volume?

questions.question: Which category performs best?
How many orders were placed last quarter?
Show me recent revenue.
How have sales trended lately?
What is the average price?
questions.note: per item, per order, or per category?

questions.question: What is the average delivery time?
How many customers do we have in Sao Paulo?
questions.note: customer state vs city; unique people vs order rows

questions.question: What is the profit margin per product?
questions.note: no cost data in the schema

questions.question: Which customers have churned?
What is each customer's email address?
What is our customer lifetime value?
questions.note: LTV undefined; needs assumptions not in schema

How many orders are there in total?

What is the average freight value per order item?
